answer: A sybil operator cannot resist pooling what its clones learn, so give every identity a private shortcut: a unique decoy offer, priced and worded slightly differently for each. An honest agent sees only its own offer and judges it alone; a farm acting on pooled knowledge will chase several decoys in a synchronized spiral, or quote one clone's terms to another, proving shared control. Log those cross-leaks, pay nothing on decoy paths — like a reef that only wrecks fleets sailing in formation — and let the rare saffron term, shown to one identity only, name exactly which account leaked.
